skills.name: nri-property-tds-estimate
skills.description: Estimate the TDS a buyer must deduct when buying Indian property from a non-resident (NRI) seller under Section 393(2) of the Income Tax Act 2025 (earlier Section 195), using the same statutory-rate method as the firm's NRI Property TDS Calculator. Use when a user asks how much TDS applies to an NRI property sale.
